{"id":"KITH-1ln3.10","title":"kith-tui: eprintln! to stderr overwrites the TUI screen","description":"Found in chinwag/kith-tui live smoke test 2026-10-30 (kith 556bf4c, chinwag 830be27).

Evidence: kith-tui run without a stderr redirect, then the server restarted. The SSE reconnect messages print straight into the alternate screen and the status bar gets mangled (tmux capture-pane):

 Connected | bob@elsewhere.example kith-tui: SSE stream error: http error: error decoding response body; reconnecting in 2s
 Reconnecting (wil  retry auto atically) | bob@elsewhere.examplekith-tui: SSE stream error: http error: error sending request for url
 (https://localhost:8443/jmap/eventsource?types=%2A&closeafter=no&ping=30); reconnecting in 4s
 Connected | bob@e sewhere.exa ple

The garbage stays until the cells are redrawn. Sources: client.rs run_sse/spawn_sse and many event.rs eprintln!("kith-tui: ...") call sites (Message/changes, Message/get, Chat/get errors). Any server hiccup during a live demo corrupts the screen.

Workaround for the demo: run with 2>/path/to/kith-tui.log.
Fix direction: send diagnostics to a log file (or tracing to a file) or to the status bar (set_error); never write to stdout/stderr while the alternate screen is active.
